name: GMTech Inc.
summary: GMTech Inc., operating through its subsidiary Anptech Inc., delivers comprehensive information technology consulting services across North America. Their expertise encompasses the creation of custom development solutions, including customer relationship management (CRM) platforms, sophisticated corporate websites, and mobile applications. Beyond development, they also provide essential maintenance and ongoing support services. Established in 2022, GMTech Inc. maintains its headquarters in New York, New York.
